title: Safe Tonight
plainTitle: Find shelter, food and a shower
why: It's hard to plan anything when you're hungry, tired or unsafe. Shelters also have staff who can help with the next steps.
tasks: Call the Homeless Hotline at 614-274-7000 (open 24/7) to get a shelter bed
Find a free meal near you
Ask the shelter where you can shower and do laundry
celebration: You're safe tonight. That's the foundation for everything else.

title: Get Your Mail
why: Your ID, benefits and job paperwork all come by mail, so you need an address first.
tasks: Ask your shelter if you can receive mail there
If not, call 211 and ask where you can get a mailing address
Write the full address down and keep it with you
celebration: Mail unlocked! Now the paperwork can find you.

title: Prove Who You Are
why: This is the biggest blocker. You need ID to get hired, open a bank account and apply for most help.
tasks: Order your birth certificate
Replace your Social Security card
Get an Ohio state ID card at the BMV
Ask your shelter or 211 about help paying any fees
celebration: ID unlocked! That's the hardest step, and you did it.

title: Get Connected
why: Employers, caseworkers and housing programs need a way to reach you.
tasks: Check if you qualify for a free phone through Lifeline
Apply online or ask a shelter or library to help you apply
Save important numbers in your new phone
celebration: You're connected! People can reach you now.

title: Claim Your Support
plainTitle: Apply for food and health benefits
why: Help with food and health care means more of your money can go toward housing.
tasks: Apply for SNAP (food help)
Apply for Medicaid (health care)
Open the Guide tab for a step-by-step walkthrough
celebration: Support claimed! That's money and stress off your shoulders.

title: Get Job-Ready
why: With ID, a phone and an address, you're ready to be hired.
tasks: Get free interview clothes
Make a simple resume at a library or job center
Apply to 3 entry-level jobs this week
celebration: You're job-ready! Every application is a step forward.

title: Start Earning
plainTitle: Get a job and open a bank account
why: A bank account keeps your money safe and avoids check-cashing fees.
tasks: Accept a job offer
Open a free or low-cost bank account
Set up direct deposit for your paycheck
celebration: You're earning! Look how far you've come.

title: Home Base
why: This is the goal: a stable place to call home.
tasks: Save a little from each paycheck toward a deposit
Ask the Homeless Hotline about housing programs
Get free legal help if you have old evictions or fines
